subject: Privacy & Digital Rights
title: 23andMe's DNA Data Leak
description: A fast breakdown of 23andMe's DNA Data Leak for builders.

hook.text: People paid 23andMe to analyze their DNA. Then hackers stole genetic data of nearly 7 million users.

buildup.text: 23andMe stored sensitive genetic ancestry and health predisposition data in its cloud databases.

discovery.text: Attackers used credential stuffing to access accounts and scraped DNA-relative data across millions of profiles.

twist.text: Genetic data can't be changed like a password. Once your DNA data leaks, it's compromised forever.

climax.text: You can change your password. You can't change your DNA. Genetic data breaches are permanent.

punchline.text: Passwords reset. DNA doesn't. That data is forever.

quiz.question: Why are genetic data breaches especially concerning?
options: DNA data cannot be changed or reset like passwords
Genetic data is publicly available anyway
Hackers can clone people from stolen DNA
